def run(_context):
    import json
    # Inspect the part geometry and existing CAM
    scene = mb.inspect()
    print("SCENE:")
    print(json.dumps(scene, indent=2))
    print("\nFACES (body 0):")
    faces = mb.faces(body_index=0)
    print(json.dumps(faces, indent=2))

def run(_context):
    import json
    
    # Check WCS state of existing setup
    wcs = mb.wcs_state(setup="Setup1")
    print("WCS STATE (Setup1):")
    print(json.dumps(wcs, indent=2))
    
    # List available tools in TIW library
    tools = mb.list_library_tools(contains="TIW")
    print("\nTIW LIBRARY TOOLS:")
    for t in tools:
        print(json.dumps(t))

def run(_context):
    import json
    
    # Get full tool list
    tools = mb.list_library_tools(contains="TIW")
    print("FULL TIW TOOL LIST:")
    for t in tools:
        print(f"  [{t['index']:2d}] {t['description']:45s} D={t['diameter_mm']:.4f}mm  CR={t['corner_radius_mm']:.4f}mm  FL={t['flute_length_mm']:.2f}mm  flutes={t['flutes']}")
    
    # Check what tools are already in the document
    print("\n\nChecking strategy guides...")
    
    # Get strategy guide for face, pocket2d, contour2d, drill, adaptive2d
    for strat in ["face", "pocket2d", "contour2d", "drill", "adaptive2d"]:
        guide = mb.strategy_guide(strat)
        print(f"\n--- {strat.upper()} ---")
        for k, v in guide.items():
            print(f"  {k}: {v['expression']} ({v['unit']})")

def set_geometry(op_name, geometry, body_index=0):
    """Set or replace the geometry selection on an existing operation.
    Use this to fix a geometry error from add_operation() without recreating the op.
    geometry: {"faces":[idx,...], "type":"pocket"|"contour", "loop":.., "side":..}"""
    cam = get_cam()
    _, op = _find_op(cam, op_name)
    body = _all_bodies()[body_index]
    _select_geometry(op, body, geometry)
    adsk.doEvents()
    return {"operation": op_name, "geometry_set": True}"
}
